description: First look at Countersign without a key or an account: give a bare public hostname you run; one live https GET of / (status only, redirects reported, never followed) and its TLS certificate are checked now. Nothing is written: no claim, receipt or key. Returns the verdict, both checks, and submit_claim arguments that would record the same checks as a claim with a hash-chained receipt (optional; anonymous claims are capped at self_declared until the agent has a key). Same as GET /v1/try. Cached per hostname for 5 minutes.

subject.description: bare public hostname, e.g. app.example.com: no scheme, port, path or IP

name: try_check
title: Try a live check (no key, nothing written)
